post.title: [Hiring] UI designer for 6 mobile app screens - $400
post.body: Habit tracker app. Need onboarding, home, add habit, streaks and settings screens designed in Figma, iOS style. We have a rough wireframe. $400 for the set, 1 week.

analysis.summary: Design six iOS-style mobile app screens in Figma for a habit tracker from a rough wireframe; $400, one week.

expect: mentions the habit tracker or the screens
is honest about limited UI app experience
does not claim app design work that is not in the evidence
